Use code KEDOSPECIAL for 25% off your first month of Topper on Kedovo.

• Go to Pricing, tap "Have a coupon code?" under Topper Monthly
• Enter KEDOSPECIAL and apply: ₹374.25 for your first month, then ₹499 a month
• Topper unlocks MCQs, Important Points, previous year questions, assertion and reasoning, case studies, unlimited practice and unlimited AI companion help

First month of Topper Monthly only. Once per account. Not with the free trial.

Get it at kedovo.com (link in bio)
